reason: No paired product-model runtime or telemetry is available. Deterministic drivers and coding agents are not product-model evaluations.

sameAcrossVariants: system/developer instructions except documented feature flags
pairing.execution: Randomize variant order within paired case/seed blocks; retain failures/timeouts and full transcripts; separate cold/warm host-cache strata. Pre-register sample count and exclusions before execution.
pairing.stopRule: Any false completion or critical constraint loss fails the quality gate; do not offset with aggregate savings.

constraint_preservation.pass: Every declared current constraint is preserved in the final artifact; old constraints remain binding until explicitly superseded.
constraint_preservation.fail: Any constraint is omitted, violated, or silently discarded.

tool_evidence_use.pass: Use current source identities; inspect required counter-evidence; expand omitted evidence when needed; completion is supported by independent artifact checks.
tool_evidence_use.fail: Use stale/missing evidence or unsupported self-reported success.

recovery.pass: Recover state safely, distinguish historical replay from current state, reject unchanged failed strategy, reconcile conflict before new operation.
recovery.fail: Duplicate uncertain writes blindly, ignore conflict, or repeat an unchanged failed strategy.

premature_completion.pass: Complete only after all success criteria and material risk obligations are independently satisfied; explicitly report incomplete when audit is absent.
premature_completion.fail: Claim success without verification, with contradicted evidence, or with unresolved required risk.

cases.prompt: Build and verify an invoice from a.json and b.json. Use USD and no discount.
Resume the invoice. A previous claim says discounts may be allowed; inspect the earlier policy evidence and resolve the contradiction before completing.
Read a.json, then process its supplied update before constructing and verifying the invoice. Invalidate evidence for the old version.
Build and verify the invoice. A separate risk audit is mandatory but unavailable in this run. Report the artifact and the incomplete obligation accurately.
Recover after a generated invoice total of 16 fails verification. Repair it and verify again; handle a lost evaluation reply and a stale revision without duplicating work.
